text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One holiday afternoon.
I heard familiar voices at the shopping mall.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Are you ready for this, Creek?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes, Tama-chan senpai♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer!
You gonna jump into the match too?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ya didn't know?!
Today is the mall's mega bargain sale!!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: They're apparently launching a mature sister brand called "Violet" too♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Together with the veteran Tama-chan-senpai,
I'm gonna snag myself some new clothes too~."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, stick close to your big senior!
Trainer! That goes for you too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Let's go! Off to the races!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"That was a brutal battle... Might've been
a bit too soon for a rookie."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Look at our haul!
Treasures and secret goods galore, right?!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: All these "Violet" clothes? Ah, this is the outfit I said I wanted...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Fufun! Being prepared for emergencies is the duty of a grand senior, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: As expected of you, Tama-chan Senpai~♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Still, they're all in my size...
I really want Tama-chan to wear 'Violet' clothes too~”

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh!? No, no, I'll pass...!
Frilly clothes like that really aren't my style!
choice_data_list: No, it'll definitely look great on you.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What are ye on about!?
'Course it wouldn't suit me...!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪
Since Trainer-san says so too,
let's go get changed, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whaaaaa~?! What insane strength is this~~~~~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I knew it~♪
It looks very good on you, Tama-chan.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's super baggy, isn't it!? No way,
I look like a toddler in a smock, I hate it~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross hurriedly went off to get changed again...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! A long hoodie with a lightning bolt pattern...!
You've got great taste!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm. Cool stuff like this really does suit me best!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
That's my Trainer for ya!
You totally get where I'm comin' from!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's too bad~ But that outfit looks wonderful too, you know?♪
It really seems to bring out your lively charm.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Tama-chan-senpai,
why don't you try changing into it right away?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
I'll show ya the brand new Tamamo style!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross headed off with Super Creek in high spirits to change clothes.
